title: Bundled ChartSearchAI or the Hub, on one shared 12B engine
summary: Seventeen questions about three HIV patients, some with follow-ups (35 answers per setup), asked through three setups that all send their model calls to the same Gemma 4 12B engine: ChartSearchAI's bundled answer path on its default settings, the Hub's plain answer path, and the Hub's checked profile, which reviews each answer and labels what its checks found. One automated judge graded each question.
takeaway: On the same engine, the Hub's plain answer path scored 78.9 and bundled ChartSearchAI 59.8. The gap comes from things the bundled path does not have: it does not tell the model today's date, it has no guideline knowledge base or date checks, and its repetition penalty garbles long lists when it reads the whole chart. The checked profile (78.4) was the most complete but marked most In-Depth sections red, mostly guideline statements that cite a chart record which does not back them.

earlier.label: 22 Oct, second run
earlier.note: Bundled was set to read only a question-scoped slice of the chart instead of its default full chart. Benchmark: bundled 64.6, Hub answer only 84.0, Hub checked 84.5.

earlier.label: 22 Oct, first run
earlier.note: The Hub answer-only setup failed every question on a profile error, so its zero scores are not a result. Bundled also read the question-scoped slice.
